title: [Dev] NSv3 full sync isn't getting boluses except for Smb and sync stops
symptom: After a fresh install or clearing the database of AAPSClient, doing a full sync with NSv3 does not get all boluses except for SMB, and the sync stops. AAPSClient is spamming logs and not updating, and boluses are not visible in Nightscout treatments or graph.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. It is suggested that it might be a Nightscout or mongo issue, and it is related to issue #3623.
fix: The issue was closed as related to #3623, but no specific fix is stated in this thread.
evidence_quote: this is probably NS or mongo issue
